title: Diff (one amendment)
description: A single amendment to one clause of one instrument. The diff never carries its own publication time: the ledger assigns that on appending. effective_from is a claim made by the amendment, and the engine decides what it is worth.

clause_id.description: Dotted identifier, e.g. 1.1. Compared as an opaque string; ordering is natural-numeric.

authority.description: The body that issued the amendment.

source_ref.description: Circular, order or notification number as printed.

effective_from.description: Claimed date of effect, with an explicit offset. Under the tora regime it is clipped so it can never precede publication.

subject.description: What the clause governs, for the discretion probe.

value.description: What the clause requires on that subject.

scope.description: Fact attributes the clause applies to. A missing attribute means any value. Empty scope applies to every fact pattern.
